notes.title: BIG UPDATE: V0.5
notes.content:
Hello players,
I am happy to announce that the biggest update of the game so far has been released. Now you are probably asking yourself, "what has changed?". 

Well, a lot: first of all, there is now a new game mode, the Scenario Editor. Create your very own game world there. There is a manager for this, in which you can set the number of resources, build freely and even convert soldiers or buildings to enemy units. For example, build an entire level in which you have only three archers and have to eliminate a horde of enemies, let your creativity run wild. 

Secondly, the UI. It is now a lot cleaner and there are a few new submenus. For example, the building menu has been completely reworked and is now clearer and more compact. 

Thirdly, there is a revision of the AI. Many problems, such as villagers suddenly stopping, have been fixed. But also in the combat system, everything has been completely redone, so hopefully there will be no more bugs. Efficiency has also reached completely new levels, so individual units only need a fraction of the computing power as before.

Fourth, there are some new effects. Destruction of buildings, fires and battle effects have been completely remastered and are now a lot prettier to look at.

Fifth, a reworking of the sound effects. The same sounds were constantly repeated during wood chopping, archery or sword fights. This is now a thing of the past, as more sound effects have made it into the game.

Here I would like to apologize again personally that nothing came for so long, I started a study and there was a lot to do on this game before the update could come out like this. I hope you have fun and have a great day :)

Have a great day!

notes.title: Update v0.2 is out now!
notes.content:
Hey guys!
The new update v0.2 is out now :D

The update contains a better wave system, upgrades for buildings, skills for villagers and a peaceful mode.

Changelog:
- Added a new wave system with a timer, which shows how much time is left before the wave starts
- Added upgrades for production buildings. The upgradesystem will be enhanced over time and is not completly finished
- Added a new mode: Sandbox. You can build in this mode without getting attacked
- Added skills for villagers. Every villager has now some specilizations. Some are better in woodcutting, the others are better in mining, etc.
- Changed the look of the trees for a visual overhaul
- Many bugfixes and small changes

Have a great day :)

notes.title: Update V0.1.1 out now! New UI
notes.content:
Hello folks,
a new update is out now for my game Kings Town.
I want to thank you for your positive feedback and for some criticism to make the game better. Most of the players criticized the UI, so I updated it and made it prettier and more functional. it's not done yet, I want to add things and have to make a prettier start menu, but it's much better ingame. You can close windows now with ESC and I added a tutorial for new players. You can finaly invert your mouse in the options.

Changelogs:
- New UI
- Tutorial
- Support for ESC
- Villagers have axes and pickaxes in their hands when needed
- Brightness of the game is adjustable in the settings
- Inverting mouse in options
- The particles for commanding were replaced by a flag
- Houses have space for 3 villagers
- Resolution mode "Automatic"
- You can choose your rotation mode for the buildings (It was buggy before)
- Smaller things
